description: North American Seasonal Fire Assessment and Outlook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada; National Interagency Fire Center | National Interagency Coordination Center; Servicio Meteorológico Nacional. Wildland fire managers can use this outlook product to aid strategic planning efforts for the movement and mobilization of fire suppression resources among Canada, the United States, and Mexico. This product provides a monthly discussion of conditions that may affect the occurrence of wildland fires across the continent in the upcoming months. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
